study: Tiny Aya question-and-response A-PSR with a native-precision dose-matched constant
metric: equal-case exact grounded-answer success ON minus matched OFF

control.target: sum of native adaptive FP32 coefficients in integer binary32 units, computed per case and layer
control.constant: nearest representable FP32 coefficient to the target divided by realized eligible position count
control.eligible_count: native greedy generation with its original EOS and token limit
